description: A classical residential estate entrance photographed at night from a standing camera height, approximately five feet off grade, using a normal to wide lens and an off-center thirds composition that places the foreground pier in the left-center and the second pier receding to the right at medium depth. The boundary is defined by smooth cream-tone travertine or limestone masonry piers with flat beveled cap stones, connected by a decorative wrought iron fence with a circular-link pattern in matte black, with a matching gate panel visible between the piers. Dense manicured boxwood hedges and ornamental rounded shrubs in deep green fill the fence line in front and behind. The lawn beyond the gate is a sweep of perfectly maintained emerald green grass. In the background at soft focus, a two-story contemporary classical residence in smooth white stucco with large black-framed picture windows glows warmly from every room, its interior amber and cream-toned. A crescent moon is barely visible high in the deep blue-black sky above the roofline. Mature trees form a dark canopy beyond the property. The two stone piers each carry objects atop their cap stones that radiate warm amber-gold light outward and downward, washing the limestone face below in golden warmth and illuminating the iron fence sections in a gentle glow. The light pooling at the base of the piers creates warm arcs across the concrete apron. The overall palette is cream limestone, matte black wrought iron, rich green lawn and hedge, and deep night-blue sky punctuated by warm amber glow.
